prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which NFL players were both league MVP and Super Bowl MVP in the same season?
answer:
As of August 1, 2024, **seven NFL players** had won both the **league MVP** and **Super Bowl MVP** in the same season:

| Player | Season | Team | Super Bowl |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **Bart Starr** | 1966 | Green Bay Packers | Super Bowl I |
| **Terry Bradshaw** | 1978 | Pittsburgh Steelers | Super Bowl XIII |
| **Joe Montana** | 1989 | San Francisco 49ers | Super Bowl XXIV |
| **Emmitt Smith** | 1993 | Dallas Cowboys | Super Bowl XXVIII |
| **Steve Young** | 1994 | San Francisco 49ers | Super Bowl XXIX |
| **Kurt Warner** | 1999 | St. Louis Rams | Super Bowl XXXIV |
| **Patrick Mahomes** | 2022 | Kansas City Chiefs | Super Bowl LVII |

**Note:** Brett Favre won the league MVP in 1996, but **Desmond Howard**, not Favre, was Super Bowl XXXI MVP, so Favre does not qualify.
